{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = (sales['revenue'] == 999999.99)
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {qa_orders.sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = (sales['status'] == 'refunded')
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_orders.sum()}')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}')

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
